title: Vary: Accept / browser Accept header policy
meaning: Vary: Accept tells caches that the Accept request header affects the selected response representation.
If one URL can return JSON, XML, or a custom representation based on Accept, caches must not reuse one representation for incompatible Accept headers.
Browsers often send broad Accept headers such as */* or multiple document/media preferences.
RespectBrowserAcceptHeader changes how MVC treats browser Accept headers instead of ignoring them as too broad.
Vary and Accept negotiation are related but separate: negotiation chooses the response; Vary protects cache correctness.
boundary_notes: R01 covers the basic Produces/output negotiation material.
R04 is specifically the cache/browser Accept-header policy tail.
